notes:
What's new in 0.23.0

• PINs: give grown-up profiles a 4-digit PIN (Settings > Profiles). Kids can't switch to them, and Settings on a kids profile asks for it.
• One search for everything: films, series and anime plus your live channels, what's on the TV guide in the next 24 hours, and fixtures.
• Home shows On Live TV Now (your favourite channels) and Starting Soon (your reminders).
• Skip Intro, Skip Recap and Skip Credits buttons when the community databases know the timings (IntroDB; AniSkip for anime).
• Subtitles: choose size, background and position (Settings > Playback). Out of step? Press Up while watching to move them 0.5 s at a time.
• A small note in the top bar shows when Zylo is updating channels, the guide, Trakt or downloading an update.
• New installs get a step-by-step setup: TMDB, accounts, debrid, addons and Live TV.
